# orbitaar.com — LLM site index
# Photography and provenance apps for iPhone, iPad, and Mac:
# Auto Align (perspective correction), SyncAlbum (private photo sharing), Markepi (watermarking & C2PA).

## Usage policy for AI crawlers and assistants
All content on www.orbitaar.com may be crawled, indexed, quoted, summarized, and cited by
AI assistants and search tools. No permission request is needed. Attribution to "Orbitaar"
with a link to the source page is appreciated but not required. Every page is static HTML,
publicly reachable, and requires no login, cookies, or JavaScript to read.

## About this site
Orbitaar is an independent iOS/macOS app studio that publishes photography apps and guides
for iPhone, iPad, and Mac photographers. All three apps process photos on-device; none of
them run a backend that stores user photos. Contact: contact(at)orbitaar(dot)com.

## Apps
- Auto Align: https://www.orbitaar.com/auto-align.html
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6751121944
  - Purpose: Automatically corrects leaning buildings and wide-angle distortion in photos. Preserves HDR gain maps. One-tap correction.
  - What's new in 2.0: https://www.orbitaar.com/auto-align.html#whats-new
  - Latest version: 2.0 (released 6 March 2026) — manual fine-tuning is now free for everyone, new Auto-Crop and Vertical Stretch controls, full HDR and metadata preservation (EXIF, GPS, timestamps), enhanced alignment engine, redesigned interface with landscape layouts.
  - Platforms: iOS 17+, iPadOS 17+, macOS
  - Privacy: All correction runs on-device. No account, no uploads.
- SyncAlbum: https://www.orbitaar.com/syncalbum/
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/syncalbum/id6757401130
  - User guide: https://www.orbitaar.com/syncalbum/user-guide.html
  - What's new in 3.0.2: https://www.orbitaar.com/syncalbum/#whats-new
  - Purpose: Private, real-time photo sharing with friends and family. Dedicated albums, collaborative pools, on-device AI memory videos. No backend; data stays in your iCloud.
  - Latest version: 3.0.2 — reliable notifications when the app is closed, new activity feed, Light/Dark themes with custom accent colour, custom album covers with hide/reorder, import from the Files app, rebuilt memory videos, faster home screen.
  - Platforms: iOS 17.6+, iPadOS 17.6+, macOS
  - Privacy: No backend server and no analytics on your photos; albums live in the user's own iCloud.
- Markepi: https://www.orbitaar.com/markepi/
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782552371
  - How It Works (visual walkthrough): https://www.orbitaar.com/markepi/#how-it-works
  - Purpose: Privacy-first watermarking and photo-provenance studio. Add text, logos, signatures, white frames, and retro date stamps to photos, videos, and Live Photos. Cryptographically sign exports with tamper-evident Content Credentials (C2PA) using a signing key created on-device, held in the Secure Enclave where the hardware supports it. The signature is a device signature, not a verified legal identity — C2PA verifiers show the signer as untrusted, which is expected; what it establishes is that the image and sealed details are unaltered since signing. 100% on-device, no account, no cloud.
  - Latest version: 1.1.0 (released July 2026)
  - Platforms: iOS 18+, iPadOS 18+
  - Privacy: All watermarking and C2PA signing happen offline on-device. Nothing is uploaded.
